policy: Research file only. Nothing here is published or stored in the database. Each record must be entered as a draft in /admin, submitted for review, and verified by an Owner or Reviewer against the cited official page before publication. 'captured' means an evidence retrieval on preparedAt returned the quoted evidence; it is NOT 'verified'. Rankings (QS / THE) and unapproved FX rates are strictly excluded.
selectionCriteria: Exactly three genuine institutions for each of the 11 configured destinations (33 institutions total).
Public or accredited non-profit research universities with established academic programmes relevant to Indian applicants.
Official institutional website on an accredited domain using https://.
At least one specific bachelor's or master's degree programme with documented duration, study mode, tuition, and entry/language requirements.
Zero reliance on rejected PDF tables: all data retrieved from official university and national portal sources.
No fabricated acceptance rates, scholarship guarantees, or estimated conversion values.
